text:
Situation: Fondaparinux sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 70 syringes (6.6 days on hand). Corvale General holds 327 syringes (30.6 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 27 syringes (15.9 days). The rule-based recommendation is to transfer 79 syringes from Corvale General to Corvale East, bringing Corvale East to 14 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1326554 of ScinoPharm Taiwan, Ltd. ended on 2026-06-23 and was classified OAI; FDA's known date for that classification is 2026-09-21. Italfarmaco S.p.A.'s most recent inspection (1250897) ended 2023-06-28 and was classified VAI.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The immediate gap is local to Corvale East. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support a transfer while maintaining its own supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 79 syringes of 7.5 mg/0.6 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Monitor FDA shortage list and inspection updates for all listed manufacturers — requires buyer review.
3. Evaluate purchase from Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited if transfer cannot meet demand — requires buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Eugia US LLC if transfer cannot meet demand — requires buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Mylan Institutional LLC if transfer cannot meet demand — requires buyer approval.
6. Evaluate purchase from Sandoz Inc. if transfer cannot meet demand — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative agent substitutions at this time.
